prompt: Which movie musical produced a song that was inspired by poetry from an American poet, who was born a week after Queen Victoria?
answer: The movie musical was **_Fame_ (1980)**. Its climactic song, **“I Sing the Body Electric,”** was inspired by Walt Whitman’s poem of the same title. Whitman was born on May 31, 1819—one week after Queen Victoria’s birth on May 24.
